change.title: Close the R2 versioned typed runtime journal inventory
change.summary: Reconciles R2-A through R2-E as one source-only inventory covering the nested V1/V2 schema, immutable identity, complete-record CAS, typed recovery outcomes, and fail-closed V1 compatibility. It reruns the focused matrix and requires an exact-SHA source gate plus independent completion review before Post-R2 Rebaseline. Production behavior is unchanged.

basis: R2-A through R2-E schema, writer, reader, recovery, compensation, and compatibility boundaries were reconciled without production changes
focused config V1/V2, one-click checkpoint and drift, transaction source contract, profile-switch, and interrupted-Gateway recovery regressions passed
the proxy lifecycle module passed with 20 passed and one explicitly ignored identity; its interrupted-Gateway recovery subset accounted for four passed and one explicitly ignored identity
the three restricted-sandbox recovery failures were permission-only; the isolated rerun passed all four executable recovery identities and retained one explicitly ignored Acceptance-boundary identity
cargo check passed and the complete Rust library serial regression passed with 487 passed, zero failed, and 41 explicitly ignored isolated or live-bound identities
the first parallel full-library run was rejected as evidence after one unrelated Codex cancel failure; that identity and the complete serial rerun both passed
the inventory preserves the F5 pre-intent gap, StopFailed behavior, current checkpoint timing, and the existing runtime_transaction operation scope
complete 15-suite GATE-SOURCE and exact-SHA clean-context completion review remain pending
